inventory.name: [NopalCyber] Entra ID OAuth Phishing via Visual Studio Code Client

properties.description: Detects successful non-interactive sign-ins to Microsoft Graph using the Visual Studio Code (VSCode) application identity. This behavior was observed in a phishing campaign where threat actors tricked users into an OAuth flow to harvest tokens. These tokens were then used to access user data, such as emails, via the Graph API.
properties.displayName: [NopalCyber] Entra ID OAuth Phishing via Visual Studio Code Client
properties.query:
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs
| where ResultType == "0"
| where UserType == "Member"
| where AppId == "aebc6443-996d-45c2-90f0-388ff96faa56"
| where ResourceIdentity == "00000003-0000-0000-c000-000000000000" or ResourceDisplayName == "Microsoft Graph"
| where AuthenticationProcessingDetails has "Oauth"
| where parse_json(DeviceDetail).isCompliant == false //Filter non-compliant devices
| extend DeviceName = tostring(parse_json(DeviceDetail).displayName)
| extend DeviceID = tostring(parse_json(DeviceDetail).deviceId)
| where not (UserPrincipalName  in ("prasad.ahire@contractpod.onmicrosoft.com") and DeviceName in ("CPAI-ahire") and DeviceID in ("0ca9a383-ec31-43fe-8b52-20ce54bb0b4e")) //user is part of Developers group
| project-reorder
    TimeGenerated,
    UserPrincipalName,
    AppDisplayName,
    IPAddress,
    Location,
    ResourceDisplayName,
    AuthenticationProcessingDetails,
    DeviceDetail,
    UserAgent,
    CorrelationId
